style: Photorealistic editorial scenes. AI-generated fictional people and settings; not photographs of actual Ownit users.
hero: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: widescreen 16:9 photograph for a developer-tool launch film and GitHub README. Create a candid documentary-style photograph of an adult female software developer, about 30, with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a charcoal cotton sweater, concentrating on an ordinary open laptop at a real oak desk in a modest Scandinavian home office. Place the person and desk on the RIGHT half; leave the LEFT half as quiet dark olive-grey wall and softly out-of-focus room for large typography in a video edit. Camera at seated eye level, three-quarter side profile, natural 35mm lens perspective. Her expression is thoughtful and unposed, looking at the laptop, not the camera. Soft daylight from an actual window on the right; genuine photographic texture, normal skin pores, flyaway hair, subtle under-eye detail, lived-in furniture, a ceramic coffee cup and closed notebook. A normal laptop with physically correct keyboard and hinge; screen angled away, no readable text. Anatomically natural hands resting on the desk, no unnecessary gestures. Restrained neutral color, subtle film grain, soft highlights, realistic exposure. This should look like a photograph shot for an editorial magazine, not a render or an advertisement with models posing. No logos, no typography, no watermarks, no floating interfaces, no neon, no holograms, no sci-fi, no plastic skin, no exaggerated bokeh. Landscape 16:9, high resolution.
